page.overview:
Who is Giorno Giovanna?

初琉乃|ja_romaji=Joruno Jovāna Haruno Shiobana|alias=Giorno Giovanna|birthname=Haruno Shiobanna|namesake=Giorno Giovanna (original counterpart) Giorno: Giovanna: Giovanni Giorgio Moroder |stand=Gold Experience Gold Experience Requiem|age=~26|birthday=~1986|gender=Male|hair=Blonde|affiliation=Passione Dio Brando|status=Deceased|death=2012|noveldebut=JORGE JOESTAR Chapter 8: Nero Nero Island|family=Dio Brando (father) Jonathan Joestar (biological father) George Joestar II (Half-brother) |occupation=Boss of Passione}}

Giorno Giovanna (ジョヴァーナ Joruno Jovāna) born Haruno Shiobana (初琉乃) is an incarnation of Giorno Giovanna from the [https://jojo.fandom.com/wiki/Parallel_World#Unknown_Universe unknown universe], featured in the light novel JORGE JOESTAR. He inhabits the 37th universe currently as the Boss of Passione. He was a major ally and hired detective Joji Joestar to search for their Boss, and also assisted Jorge Joestar when the two incarnates were swapped from their universes.

He is also a Stand user, and still wields Gold Experience and Gold Experience Requiem.

Like his original counterpart, Giorno maintains his golden hair and his three distinctive oversized curls and his suit.

Also known as: Giorno, JoJo Part 5.
